description: Condition voirie Octobre 2018 Courbevoie is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by FULLRAMA. Road condition GRS31 Luftt Courbevoie Fullrama Leonardo da Vinci Bridge Station 5 10 2018 11 10 2018 Condition Height film water temperature 3O cm depth = TEMPERATURE2 Freezing point Percentage salt. Coverage: FULLRAMA. The portal shows the English title as "Condition road October 2018 Courbevoie" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is FULLRAMA. Its keywords include courbevoie, sol, temperature, meteo. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2020-12-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
